name: TV on the upper right wall, sofa backing an entry hall by the stairs, toys in the 77-inch niche
notes:
Alternative: the TV moves to the 93" right-upper wall, perpendicular to the window (no glare), and the KIVIK faces it with its back to the stairs side. A LACK console behind the sofa makes the floor by the stairs an entry hall on a LOHALS jute rug (drop zone, bench, shoes, a reading chair by the window); the play corner takes the whole 77" niche with two TROFAST, the LEN rug and the LÄTT table.
tv-stand-3 BESTÅ TV unit with doors, white stained oak effect, 70 7/8 x 16 1/2 x 15", right-upper wall y 22.125-93, x 244.5-261: 16.1" from the heater face (F-33), fixed to the wall per its page (F-63); tv-1 Samsung 65" on it, 2" from the wall.
sofa-1 KIVIK facing east, x 141-178.375, y 18-107.75: its north arm 12" from the heater face (F-33: upholstery 12"), so the gap between sofa and window is gone; screen 98.4" from the back-cushion line (F-37: 1.51x); the TV's center is 5.3" north of the sofa's center (the right-upper wall ends at the step); the arm end stands inside the window's span 18" from the wall (assumed-position:window); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
coffee-table-1 LACK turned 90 degrees, x 192.375-214, y 45.188-80.562: 14" in front of the sofa (F-39), 30.5" from the TV unit (F-30).
console-1 LACK console, x 125.625-141, y 35.312-90.438, against the sofa's back: the entry's drop zone (lamp-2 STORSEGEL, three GNABBAS baskets for keys, mail, hats); 53.6" of hall between it and the stair strip (F-30).
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's south arm, x 148.875-170.5, y 108.75-130.375.
floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP in the TV corner, x 250-259, y 12-21, 6" off the heater face (F-33).
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 141-259, y 8-102: the whole sofa, the coffee table and the TV unit's front stand on it.
rug-5 LOHALS jute rug 52 x 77", x 73-125, y 56-133: it fills the 53.6" between the stair strip and the console and marks the hall as the entry, its natural fiber taking the grit from shoes.
chair-1 POÄNG at the top of the hall, x 80-106.75, y 18-50.25, facing south: 12" from the heater face (F-33), 8" past the stair strip; floor-lamp-3 TÅGARP beside it (x 108-117, y 40-49); art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies on the window wall above it.
bench-1 PERJOHAN bench with storage, bottom wall x 73-112.375, beside the bottom landing: sit to put shoes on, baskets underneath; hooks-1 HÖVOLM above it at coat height and hooks-2 FLISAT at Maddie's height (about 32").
shoe-cabinet-1 BISSA, bottom wall x 114.5-133.75: anchor-required (F-21); 12" for its tilt-out; mirror-1 LILJETRÄD above it.
plant-1 FEJKA at the console's south end, x 128-137, y 92-101.
toy-storage-1 and toy-storage-2 TROFAST, the 77" right-lower niche 96.375-169.625 (73.2" of bins), x 258.125-275.5: 24" clear in front (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed; their tops are her display shelf.
rug-3 LEN play rug, x 206-258, y 103-166; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 209-233.75, y 112-130.875: 24.4" from the TROFAST fronts (F-32), 30.6" from the sofa's corner and 31.4" south of the coffee table, so the 30" way into the TV corner stays open (F-30). art-2 RÖDALM on the far wall in the play corner.
Free wall: the bottom wall x 133.75-275.5 (141.8") stays clear and reachable by a 30" path (assumed-position:door).
Right side (F-61): the 77" right-lower wall carries two TROFAST (73 1/4"); the 93" upper section carries the TV, as the brief allows (play on the 77" only).
Not placed: the BESTÅ toy drawers, SMÅSTAD bench and kid's POÄNG (no room for a reading corner in front of the TROFAST's 24" without closing the way into the TV corner; a BESTÅ sideboard on the free bottom wall would close the play corner's 30" access too), the chaise sofa and IDANÄS (c), KALLAX units (c, d), KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE (d), LAUTERS.
Stairs: nothing on the x 0-36 band (F-40, assumed-position:stairs); both 36" landings stay clear, and the 36" strip beside the band (x 36-72) is kept as a walkway joining them, so each landing meets the open floor with at least 30" (F-30). Nothing she can climb stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown.
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; every TV unit is fixed to the wall as its page says, and the TV gets an anti-tip strap; tall storage is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x3 (console shelf).
